## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement.

## Which area does it belong to?

- [ ] Desktop Shell / Window Manager / Personalization
- [ ] System & Sync (VFS, Backup, Settings, Plugins)
- [ ] Productivity / Study / CS Lab / Office
- [ ] Developer Toolkit / Media Center / AI Workspace
- [ ] Arcade Game
- [ ] Accessibility / Localization (EN/DE)

## Constraints Checklist

- [ ] Works 100% client-side / offline without requiring a hosted backend
- [ ] Respects zero-tracking / zero-telemetry privacy principles
